title: Classic Krabi and Phuket Holiday
alt: Long tail boats on the sand at Ao Nang beach below the Krabi cliffs
transport: Private sedan transfers with shared tours and speedboat crossings

expert.name: Ananya Iyer
expert.quote: Krabi first, then four nights in Phuket. The last day is deliberately empty so you leave rested.
expert.tip: Land in Phuket and drive straight to Krabi while you are still fresh. Keep the 4 Islands tour and the Phi Phi tour apart by a day, as both are long on the water.

summary: Seven days on the Andaman coast. Two nights in Ao Nang with the Krabi 4 Islands tour, then four nights in Patong with a Phuket city tour, a Phi Phi island day and a final day with nothing booked.
included: Included: 6 nights in Krabi and Phuket with daily breakfast; Krabi 4 Islands speedboat tour with a lunch box; Phuket city tour; Phi Phi islands speedboat tour with lunch; 12 airport, intercity and sightseeing transfers.
not_included: Not included: international flights; visa charges; travel insurance; island and temple entry fees; meals other than those listed; personal expenses.

1: Arrival at Phuket International Airport and private sedan transfer on to Krabi
Check in at Timber House in Ao Nang and settle in
Optional: the Emerald Pool, the Ao Luk mangroves or Klong Thom hot springs
2: Breakfast, then shared transfer to the Ao Nang pier
Speedboat transfer out to Koh Poda, Tup island and Chicken island
Snorkel the shallows and stop at Phra Nang beach, lunch box on board
Return shared transfer to your hotel in the afternoon
3: Breakfast, check out and private sedan transfer by road to Phuket
Check in at Club Bamboo in Patong for the next four nights
Afternoon free on the beach or beside the pool
Optional: Freedom Beach by long tail boat or Wat Srisoonthorn
4: Breakfast, then shared transfer for the Phuket city tour
Wat Chalong, Old Phuket Town and Karon viewpoint over the three bays
Back by mid afternoon with the evening free
5: Breakfast, then shared transfer down to the Phuket pier
Speedboat transfer out to the Phi Phi group for the whole day
Maya Bay, Viking Cave, Loh Samah Bay and Monkey Beach, with lunch
Return speedboat and shared transfer to Patong in the evening
6: Breakfast, then a full day with nothing at all booked
Optional: Kata beach, Banana beach or quiet Tri Trang beach
Optional: an evening along Bangla Road
7: Breakfast and an unhurried check out
Private sedan transfer to Phuket International Airport

stops.name: Krabi
stops.accom: 2 nights · Breakfast included · Deluxe room · 3★ · Timber House in Ao Nang, close to the beach road

program.name: Ao Nang and the 4 Islands
program.description: Two nights under the Ao Nang cliffs with a speedboat tour of Koh Poda, Tup island, Chicken island and Phra Nang beach.

activities.name: Krabi 4 Islands by Speedboat
activities.description: A speedboat day across Koh Poda, Tup island and Chicken island, with snorkelling, Phra Nang beach and a lunch box on board.

activities.name: The Emerald Pool
activities.description: A spring fed pool in the Khao Phra Bang Khram forest inland from Krabi, clear green and warm all year.

activities.name: Klong Thom Hot Springs
activities.description: Warm water running over smooth rock into forest pools, usually paired with the Emerald Pool on the same drive.

stops.name: Phuket
stops.accom: 4 nights · Breakfast included · Deluxe room · 3★ · Club Bamboo in Patong, a short walk from the beach

program.name: Patong, the old town and Phi Phi
program.description: Four nights in Patong with a city tour, a full day at the Phi Phi islands and a last day left completely open.

activities.name: Phuket City Tour
activities.description: A half day run through Wat Chalong, the painted shophouse streets of Old Phuket Town and Karon viewpoint.

activities.name: Phi Phi Islands by Speedboat
activities.description: A full day across the Phi Phi group with Maya Bay, Viking Cave, Loh Samah Bay and Monkey Beach, and lunch on the tour.

activities.name: Kata Beach
activities.description: A quieter curve of sand south of Patong, good for swimming and a short ride from the hotel.

activities.name: Banana Beach
activities.description: A small bay on the north west coast with calm water and shade, reached down a steep track off the main road.
